resources.string: Hotspot devices only · Phone apps bypass WireGuard
PhoneHome sends Wi-Fi hotspot clients through your selected WireGuard profile. The phone itself keeps its normal internet connection. No root and no software or proxy settings on clients.

Experimental · Android 13+

1. Install Shizuku and start it using Wireless debugging (or ADB). Restart Shizuku after each phone reboot.
2. Authorize PhoneHome below.
3. Set your Wi-Fi hotspot name and password in Android settings, then leave the hotspot off.
4. Import a WireGuard profile with an IPv4 address, IPv4 DNS server, and AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0. Toggle it on to start both WireGuard and the hotspot.

This version shares IPv4 (TCP, UDP and DNS). Native IPv6 is not advertised. Providers must supply a standard WireGuard config; OpenVPN and proprietary VPN apps are not supported.

Hidden tethering APIs vary by device. PhoneHome checks the selected upstream and attempts to stop Wi-Fi sharing if it changes. This is NOT a guaranteed system kill switch: Android may briefly fall back to another upstream, especially if a process crashes. Do not rely on it for leak-sensitive use until verified on your device.
Shizuku authorized. Import a profile, then turn its switch on.
